title: Authentication and authorization — concept map
intro: Authentication proves who is calling your API; authorization decides what they may do. This module covers JWT bearer flow (signed, not encrypted), policy-based authorization with custom handlers, claims transformation, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, custom API key handlers, and OWASP API Security Top 10 mitigations in ASP.NET Core.

  RT --> AUTHN[UseAuthentication\nJwtBearer ApiKeyHandler]

conceptCards.title: AuthN vs AuthZ
conceptCards.summary: UseAuthentication sets HttpContext.User. UseAuthorization enforces policies. 401 = no valid identity. 403 = identity ok, permission denied.
conceptCards.example: Missing Bearer → 401; valid JWT without Admin role → 403

conceptCards.title: JWT bearer flow
conceptCards.summary: Signed not encrypted. Validate iss aud exp signature. Access token to API; refresh token only at token endpoint. BFF + HttpOnly cookie for browsers.

conceptCards.title: Policy-based auth
conceptCards.summary: AddPolicy + IAuthorizationRequirement + IAuthorizationHandler. [Authorize(Policy)]. Resource handlers for ownership.

conceptCards.title: Claims and transformation
conceptCards.summary: JWT maps to claims. RoleClaimType must match IdP. IClaimsTransformation enriches roles before AuthZ.

conceptCards.title: OAuth and OIDC
conceptCards.summary: Authorization code + PKCE for users. Client credentials for services. API validates access token not ID token.

conceptCards.title: Custom handlers and API keys
conceptCards.summary: AuthenticationHandler for X-Api-Key. Hash at rest. Multiple schemes. Rate limit per client_id.

conceptCards.title: OWASP API Top 10
conceptCards.summary: BOLA #1 — resource authorization. Rate limits. Harden CORS and errors. Audit 401/403/429.
